caption: The drawing depicts a leaping carousel horse oriented toward the right, with its legs extended forward and back as if in mid-gallop. The horse is a light gray color with a white mane and tail, and has darker accents on its hooves and around the muzzle. It is fitted with a red bridle decorated with circular gold elements, and a similarly styled red and gold breastcollar and girth. A black leather saddle with a red trim and a yellow decorative fringe is situated on the horse's back, accompanied by a metal stirrup hanging down on the near side. The horse also features a brown strap running from the girth to the stirrup. The background is plain and light-colored, and some small pencil writing appears on the lower right corner of the paper. The overall composition centers the horse, with all the details clearly visible against the blank backdrop.
title: Carousel Horse
